desc:
Etsy Ads setup and tuning means choosing which listings deserve a promotion budget, switching ads on and adjusting them from real results. Ecom Swift LLC does this inside your own Etsy shop, so your ad money goes to the items most likely to earn it.

## What is Etsy Ads setup and tuning?

Etsy Ads is the advertising tool inside Etsy that shows your listings higher in search results and category pages, and charges you when a shopper clicks. Setup means deciding which listings to promote and how much to spend each day. Tuning means reading the results after the first days and changing both choices.

Ecom Swift LLC handles both steps in your shop. The ad spend is paid to Etsy by you, and we never touch your payment details.

## Why ads waste money without a plan

Etsy makes it easy to switch ads on for every listing and walk away. The result is often a daily budget spread across items that get clicks but rarely sell, such as a listing with weak photos, a price that does not cover fees, or a title that attracts the wrong shopper. Each of those clicks costs money and returns nothing.

A plan fixes the order of the work. First the listings are checked for quality and margin, then the best ones are promoted, then the numbers are read and the weak ones are removed.

## How good ad management changes your results

An ad buys attention, not sales. A click only pays back when the listing turns that visitor into an order, so the listing itself decides whether the ad works. Strong photos, a fair price, clear shipping and a matching title all raise the share of clicks that end in a purchase.

Etsy Ads uses one daily budget for the shop and decides which of your promoted listings to show. That is why the list of included listings matters so much. A short list of solid sellers gives the budget somewhere useful to go. Margin matters as well, because an ad for a low-margin item can cost more than the profit it makes. We set the budget from your own costs, not from a round number.

## What a well-run Etsy Ads setup includes

- A review of your listings for photo quality, price, reviews and stock before any money is spent.
- A shortlist of listings chosen for ads, based on past views, favorites and orders.
- A daily budget worked out from your margins and what you are comfortable spending.
- Ads turned off for listings that need fixing first.
- A written note of what was switched on and why.
- A mid-run review of clicks, orders and cost per order for each promoted listing.
- Changes to the list after that review: some listings removed, others added.
- A plain explanation of Offsite Ads settings and how they affect your fees.
- A next-month plan covering budget, listings to watch and seasonal items.

## What we do

We start by going through your listings and your shop stats. We mark the ones that are ready for ads, the ones that need small fixes and the ones that should not be promoted at all. Then we set the daily budget and switch ads on for the chosen items in your Etsy Ads dashboard.

After a few days of data, we read the results listing by listing. Items that attract clicks and no orders are paused, and the budget moves toward the ones that sell. In the Standard and Premium packages we also fix listing problems that hold back weak ad items, and Premium adds a second tuning round and a month plan. The Basic package covers the setup and a budget plan.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Promote listings that already sell, or that are clearly good and new.
- Keep a daily budget you can afford even on a slow week.
- Give the ads several days of data before judging them.
- Check each listing's photos and price before adding it.
- Compare ad cost with your profit per order, not with revenue.

**Avoid:**
- Turning on ads for every listing in the shop.
- Raising the budget after one good day.
- Promoting items that are out of stock or slow to ship.
- Judging ads by clicks alone.
- Changing many settings at once, which hides what worked.

## Who this service is for

It suits a seller who tried Etsy Ads once, saw money leave and could not tell what it bought. It also suits a shop with steady organic orders that wants to add promotion carefully, and a new seller with a handful of strong items and a small budget who does not want to guess.

Results depend on your products, season and competition, so we describe what the work improves and do not promise sales.

## What we need from you

Tell us your monthly ad budget limit, your best items and any items you do not want promoted. We also need your approximate costs for materials and shipping, so the budget fits your margins. Access is given by inviting us to your shop with limited permissions where Etsy allows it, or by working alongside you on a shared screen. Please never send your password. After you order, we send a short checklist and keep you updated until the report arrives.
